description: GET /v1/paymaster/usage - paginated sponsorship attempts for this merchant, newest first. denied_* rows carry the refusal reason; "targets" lists every call target in execution order and "target" is the first, so a batch is one row; when no call was decoded, "targets" is empty and "target" is "0x". denied_chain, denied_entrypoint, denied_origin and denied_malformed are sampled (at most 20 rows per client and status per 10 minutes per API instance). Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Read-only.

clientId.description: Publishable client id, e.g. pmc_live_abcd - not the client UUID.

mode.description: sponsored = merchant-paid gas, user_paid = gas paid in an ERC-20.

name: paymaster_usage_get
title: Read paymaster sponsorship activity
